name: Attachment pattern filter + extension extraction
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises attachment_pattern_step and extract_extension_step chained inside a single foreach, the same shape used throughout the legacy mailglob-derived workflows: attachment_pattern_step gates each item on '*.csv' (setting @stop for that iteration only, since foreach resets @stop per item - non-matching items don't block the ones after them), extract_extension_step then sets 'ext' from the surviving attachment's filename, and save_attachment_step routes it into a per-extension folder via ${ext}. Use with example-data/emails/mixed_attachments.eml, which has two attachments: 'weekly-summary.csv' (matches, saved to ./out/attachment-pattern-and-extension/csv/) and 'internal-notes.txt' (does not match '*.csv', skipped - confirms only the matching item makes it through).
